  • Class
    Description
    ClientEyeRuntime
    Loader-neutral owner of mob, boat, placed-head, framed-item, and held eye simulations and their lifecycle, and of the scope that tells an item draw which animation it belongs to.
    ClientEyeRuntime.BoatSimulations
    World-owned boat pupils, retained and simulated only while recently rendered.
    ClientLifecycle
    Per-tick and disconnect housekeeping for client-side eye state, shared by every loader's client hooks.
    ClientNetworkHandler
    Applies the five server-to-client payloads on the client game thread.
    ClientRenderLayers
    Installs the vanilla-model eye layer on living renderers after renderer rebuilds.
    EyeInspector
    Client action-bar verdict for whether the aimed entity or placed mob head can currently receive googly eyes.
    GooglyTracker
    Per-entity client-side eye state: the GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil-physics simulator for every configured eye, plus which BehaviorInstance (if any) is currently playing on that entity.
    GooglyTracker.EyeInfo
    Physics state for one pupil: its position and velocity in the eye's unit disk, the head orientation used to derive angular forcing, and the non-physical overlay values (grow/blink/tint) an active behavior writes each tick.
    GuiItemEyes
    Scopes GUI presentation keys around item drawing, and owns the view-keyed simulations those keys select.
    GuiItemEyes.Key
    Coordinates are used only for generic previews; slots and cursor items use logical indexes.
    GuiItemEyes.Kind
    What a GuiItemEyes.Key identifies an item by.
    GuiItemEyes.Simulations
    View-owned item simulations with a UI clock independent of world ticks and pause.
    HandItemEyes
    World-owned simulations of eyes in third-person hands, and their connection to item draws.
    HandItemEyes.Simulations
    Disposable ambient simulations, independent for each holder's main hand and offhand.
    HeldEye
    The live eye a player holds: one GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil, stepped with the same physics as mob eyes from the holder's look and position deltas, plus the behaviors it plays.
    PresentationEyes
    One presentation's loose eye or configured eye layout and ambient expressions.
    PresentationEyes.Draw
    The animation an item draw uses and that draw's partial tick; PresentationEyes.Draw.NONE outside animated draws.
